chains.title: CREB3L4 binds the ref C allele more strongly at an unannotated element and alters PELI2
chains.element: unannotated intronic/intergenic segment; no cCRE overlap; cryptic element unproven
chains.cell_type: MCF7 (DepMap ACH-000019) breast cancer cells; relevance unproven

links.claim: QBiC-SELEX has a CREB3L4 own-model hit at this base: effect -1.314, z -37.55, meaning the ref C allele binds CREB3L4 more strongly than the alt T allele in vitro; a CIS-BP-mapped CREB3L2 model also reports ref>alt. No ENCODE ChIP-seq peak contains this base and CREB3L4 was not assayed in MCF-7, so occupancy is unknown. I choose CREB3L4 as the top non-null because it has an own-model QBiC signal and is well expressed in MCF7 (48.8 TPM, rank 68/1626), not because occupancy is demonstrated.

The variant is an intronic/intergenic base with no overlapping cCRE; the nearest dELS is 1,868 bp away, GERP is -3.12, and no ENCODE TF peak contains the base. This establishes only that no annotated element overlaps the variant; a functional cryptic element in MCF-7 is not demonstrated.

PELI2 is the nearest protein-coding gene at 230.8 kb, but GTEx v8 reports no eQTL for this variant, the only molecular QTL is for ENSG00000259868 with PIP 0.03 in brain nucleus accumbens, and PELI2 is not a dependency in breast lines. PELI2 is therefore a proximity-based candidate only, not a supported target.

MCF7 is the expression context, where CREB3L4 is expressed at 48.8 TPM (rank 68/1626); however, no MCF-7 ENCODE ChIP-seq peak is present at this base. The choice of MCF-7 as the relevant cell type is plausible from expression but not proven by occupancy.

rs11629191 has no GWAS Catalog association and no GTEx v8 eQTL; PELI2 literature is generic Pellino biology or a papillary thyroid carcinoma prognostic signature, and PELI2 is not a breast-line dependency. A CREB3L4-dependent effect on breast cancer through PELI2 is speculative.
